units.source_text: 对这着“小目”，名人一边在膝上盘指，一边注视着棋盘。

en.t: In response to this move at the small point, the Master counted variations on his knee with his fingers while gazing at the board.

units.source_text: 这场面，报社拍了许多照片和新闻纪录片。

en.t: The newspaper company took many photographs and newsreel films of this scene.

units.source_text: 在刺眼的灯光下，名人噘起双唇，把嘴紧紧闭拢，旁若无人。

en.t: Under the glaring lights, the Master pursed his lips, closed his mouth tightly, and seemed oblivious to everyone around him.

units.source_text: 我观看名人下棋，这是第三局，我觉得只要名人在棋盘前坐下，就会生出一股习习和风，使周围变得清爽畅快。

en.t: This was the third game in which I watched the Master play, and I felt that whenever he sat down before the board, a gentle breeze seemed to arise, making the air around him fresh and pleasant.
